description: This file defines the SetCookie class in the GuzzleHttp\Cookie namespace. The class models an HTTP Set-Cookie object, providing methods for parsing, manipulating, and validating cookies according to RFC 6265.

classes.name: SetCookie
classes.description: Represents an HTTP Set-Cookie header, allowing parsing from string, manipulation, and validation of cookie properties.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates a SetCookie object by parsing a Set-Cookie header string.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a SetCookie object with optional cookie data array.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Serializes the cookie object into a string suitable for header output.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the cookie data as an associative array.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the cookie name.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the cookie name, triggering deprecation warning if input is not a string.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the cookie value.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the cookie value, triggering deprecation warning if input is not a string.

methods.name: getDomain
methods.description: Retrieves the cookie domain.

methods.name: setDomain
methods.description: Sets the cookie domain, triggering deprecation warning if input is not a string or null.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Retrieves the cookie path.

methods.name: setPath
methods.description: Sets the cookie path, triggering deprecation warning if input is not a string.

methods.name: getMaxAge
methods.description: Retrieves the max-age of the cookie in seconds.

methods.name: setMaxAge
methods.description: Sets the max-age of the cookie, triggering deprecation warning if input is not an integer or null.

methods.name: getExpires
methods.description: Retrieves the expiration timestamp of the cookie.

methods.name: setExpires
methods.description: Sets the expiration timestamp of the cookie, triggers deprecation warning if input is not an int, string, or null.

methods.name: getSecure
methods.description: Checks if the cookie is marked secure.

methods.name: setSecure
methods.description: Sets the secure flag on the cookie, triggers deprecation warning if input is not boolean.

methods.name: getDiscard
methods.description: Checks if the cookie is marked as discard (session cookie).

methods.name: setDiscard
methods.description: Sets the discard flag, triggers deprecation warning if input is not boolean.

methods.name: getHttpOnly
methods.description: Checks if the cookie is HTTP-only.

methods.name: setHttpOnly
methods.description: Sets the HTTP-only flag, triggers deprecation warning if input is not boolean.

methods.name: matchesPath
methods.description: Determines if a request path matches the cookie's path according to RFC 6265.

methods.name: matchesDomain
methods.description: Determines if a domain matches the cookie's domain according to RFC 6265.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks whether the cookie has expired based on current time.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the cookie against RFC 6265 rules, returning true or error message.
